resources.string: A little clarity for your day.
Your customers, services and payments, all in one place.
Choose a customer to record a service or payment.
Every payment has a place. Pick a service to collect its balance.
Unpaid services will appear here as you record them.
Only unpaid services with a payment due date before today appear here.
This is a record of money received, not a payment request or online charge.
Record money received against this service to keep a clear history.
Imported from earlier received totals. The original payment date and method are unknown.
Use this only to correct an incorrect entry. Its amount will no longer count as received, but the original entry and your reason will stay in the ledger. This does not issue a refund.
Payment voided. The balance has been updated.
Payments are recorded separately. Editing a service never changes payment history.
Use an international number, for example +91 98765 43210. Review the recipient and message. You still need to press Send in WhatsApp; this app cannot confirm delivery.
WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business is not available. Install it, or share a service summary instead.
Hello %1$s, a friendly reminder that %2$s is pending for %3$s (service dated %4$s). Total: %5$s. Received: %6$s.%7$s\nPlease let me know once the payment is made. Thank you!
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
Add someone you work with. Keep their services, payments and follow-ups together, even offline.
Add the first appliance for this customer.
No services yet. Record the work you do here.
Used until a service is recorded. Afterwards, the latest dated service controls the next follow-up.
Leave empty if no follow-up is scheduled. The latest service by date sets the due date; same-day services use recording order.
A little follow-up goes a long way
Overdue and due today. Reminders are shared manually; nothing is sent to customers automatically.
Set a next service date on an appliance or service visit to see it here when it is due.
Hello %1$s, your %2$s service was scheduled for %3$s. Please contact me to arrange a visit. Thank you.
Delete this customer, their appliances and services? Customers with any payment history cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone without a backup.
Delete this appliance? Its services and payments will stay in the customer ledger as general services. This cannot be undone without a backup.
Delete this service? Services with any payment history cannot be deleted. Related follow-ups will be recalculated.
Your records deserve a safety net
There is no account or cloud sync. Uninstalling the app or losing this phone can lose your records. Save an encrypted backup to a separate device or a cloud provider in Android\'s file picker.
Backup recommended: no backup has been saved in the last 7 days. Recent changes may not be protected.
Use at least 12 characters and keep the password safe. We cannot recover it. The password is not saved in the app.
Enter the password used to create this backup.
Restore REPLACES all current customers, appliances, services and payments, including correction history. Back up the current records first. Settings are not restored.
I understand that my current records will be replaced.
Optional, on this device only. Android battery settings can delay delivery. The follow-up list always remains available.
Notifications are blocked in Android settings. Enable them there to receive reminders.

No ads, analytics, login, or internet permission. Contact import reads only the phone entry you select; no full address-book permission is requested. Photos you select are copied to private storage and compressed without original metadata. Records and photos stay on this phone unless you export a password-encrypted backup. Sharing sends the selected text, not photos, to an app you choose. Protect your phone with a screen lock and only collect details you need.

Free pilot • INR charges • 40,000 total records • 8 MB backup limit, including photos\nNo cloud sync, automated messages or payment processing. Payments are individual ledger entries; WhatsApp reminders are sent manually.
Working… Please keep the app open.
Pick one phone entry. Review the name and number before saving. Importing replaces these two fields; your address is unchanged.
Amount received so far in INR *
Enter the total received for this service so far. For example: charge 100, received 50, pending 50.
Enter valid charge and received amounts.
One photo per record, copied from the system picker. Images are compressed to at most 1280 pixels and 256 KB. Photos are included in the 8 MB encrypted-backup limit.
A daily reminder when services are due. Timing may vary with battery settings.
